lines.text: I'm on the fence about the trip.

data.define: Used when you are unsure which option to choose.

example.text: I'm on the fence about the trip.

misuse.text: Don't say 'on the fence' about a real fence.

publish.title: What does "on the fence" mean?
publish.value: On the fence = I haven't decided yet. Example: "I'm on the fence about the trip." (casual English).
